full_version:
Design Engineer, Studio Team, Restream

I researched where users dropped off in the signup funnel and redesigned the plan-selection step in Figma before building it in React. Completion grew from 41% to 58% across ~120K signups.

I took that step from the research to a Figma design to working React code, and I kept each screen consistent through review. I built a token-driven component library in React and TypeScript with Storybook documentation, so every new screen reused the same tested parts and reviews stayed short. Every review checked that the design and the code still matched.

Portfolio: portfolio.example.dev

I work from Exampleland, UTC+2, and invoice clients as a registered sole trader.

I can walk you through the plan-selection redesign on a call.
